opening.argument: The offer is presented as a PUBG Mobile hack promising free UC and Battle Points through an external account-connection page. The speaker directs viewers to “gameshacks.com” and says they will connect their account to “generate free UC and BP.” The process is not merely a claim of a reward: it requires installing two apps and connecting to a VPN for verification, while a displayed page requests connection to a PUBG Mobile account. The speaker then claims the currency will appear in the game after the process. These features establish a low-barrier method for acquiring in-game assets while leaving no evidence that the site is authorized, that any reward was delivered, or what data or permissions the process involved.
